mentions.name: FourierX
mentions.description: A web app that streams never-ending DJ mixes generated by a tiny ML model (~2.4M parameters) with 20-60+ second transitions between tracks. It currently streams the builder's personal music collection, primarily drum and bass. It uses HTTP3 WebTransport on Chrome and falls back to WebSocket for other browsers.
mentions.audience: An audience of music listeners / fellow ravers who enjoy continuous DJ-style music mixes.
mentions.source_excerpt: I made a tiny ML model (~2.4 mil parameters) that can mix music in a never-ending continuous stream where transitions between tracks are 20-60+ seconds long.

evidence.value: I made a tiny ML model (~2.4 mil parameters) that can mix music in a never-ending continuous stream where transitions between tracks are 20-60+ seconds long.
